outcome.technical:
SWEEP (tools/sweep-selftests.py): new flag --encoding-subjects narrows an --encoding pass to the suites it is about. pass_knobs(enc) = the env keys locale_pins sets for posix and nt (LANG, LC_ALL, PYTHONIOENCODING, PYTHONUTF8) plus the code page itself. That is derived from what the pass actually sets, not a hand list. encoding_subjects() keeps a swept file when its own text, or a subject module's, names a knob as a whole word. suite_subjects(repo) maps tests/test_<name> to modules through _output_lints._test_name_for over the classifier's roots. An unreadable file or subject counts as naming a knob (the failure direction is to include). main refuses the flag without --encoding or beside a named list (exit 2) and refuses an empty selection. It prints 'encoding subjects: N of the M swept files ...' with the knobs, then shards the selection. Live selection: 16 of 193 files, 3855 slot-s of 7978 on .github/sweep-costs.json. Block-level selection was measured and gains nothing: a shared helper in test_drive_phase reads PYTHONIOENCODING, so 119 of its 121 blocks match. New cases es1-es4. VERIFY (tools/verify.sh): selftests-cp1252 (per-run) now runs '--encoding cp1252 --encoding-subjects'. New release-tier slice selftests-cp1252-whole runs '--encoding cp1252' over the whole tree, and --shard accepts it. Local --release is unchanged, because on POSIX the per-run selftests-stress already sweeps the whole tree with the codec pinned. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): the cp1252 include row's slice is ${{ inputs.tier == 'release' && 'selftests-cp1252-whole' || 'selftests-cp1252' }}. The windows cp1252 leg gets parts: 3 (a row keyed by os+leg after the os row) and excludes shards 4 and 5. Job count read through gate-parity's _matrix_cells: per-run 16 (was 18 at HEAD), release 17 (was 19). GATE-PARITY (tools/gate-parity.py): job_slices expands a _TIER_CHOICE value into a release arm and a per-run arm, and each run carries tiers (_tier_arms, _run_tiers). slice_drift and per_run_named now read run-level tiers; the prove-gates anchors 'if "per-run" in tiers:
 continue', 'if name not in listed:' and 'if want - have:' are intact. New lint encoding_leg_drift(text, listed) is wired into slice_verdict. It reports a windows cell a per-run run starts whose slice's --list command sweeps --encoding without --encoding-subjects. It also reports when no windows cell a release-tier run starts sweeps the whole tree. The rule reads both sides at once: the ci.yml arm and verify.sh's printed command. The windows part pin gains WINDOWS_ENCODING_SHARDS = 3 for slices encoding_sweep_shape reads as --encoding sweeps (sv13/sv15 adjusted through _ci_shape_findings). New cases el0-el4 cover the live claim, per-run-whole from three sides, release dropped from three sides, an allow case with the whole leg in a separate release-only job, and arm parsing. Docs: CONTRIBUTING.md selftests-cp1252 paragraph; CLAUDE.md hook-coverage sentence made precise plus a command line. RUNS: gate-parity exit 0; gate-parity --selftest 103/103; sweep --selftest 160/160; ruff and vermin clean on both .py files; prose_number_claims, doc_prose_numbers and house_style_violations show no hit in the changed files. Named sweep over 18 dependants (test__refs, test__output_lints, test__deps, _harness, test__output, test__impact, test__manifest_phases, test__affected_tests, affected, measure-affected-miss, check-prohibitions, ci-verified, release, _suite, count-ui-pins, measure-context, test_derive_phase_gate, test__gate_derive) is 18/18 files ok, 1466 cases. ruby YAML.load_file parses ci.yml and shows the include and exclude rows as intended. Each anchor occurs exactly once (counted), and the probe's M8 is that allow row: el0 and el3 went red. c2 was already red before this task: the sv7 row's anchor '        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]' occurs 0 times in HEAD's ci.yml (git show HEAD:... | grep -c is 0). suite_subjects was also derived, by the tree-walk arm; it now takes a required repo, following retired_suite_files' documented precedent, and is no longer derived. The prove-gates anchors '        leg: [plain, stress, cp1252]' and 'run: sh tools/verify.sh --only lint,runner,e2e' are intact, and with the leg mutation slice_drift still fires (checked in memory). PREDICTED PER-RUN RUNNER-MINUTES (estimate, measured once, no CI run of this shape yet): cell = overhead + rate x slot-seconds, overhead 45 s/cell (ci.yml's measured 12-41 s before plus under 5 s after the sweep step). Run 41070108164's windows cp1252 cells: 453+502+550+581 = 2086 s = 34.8 runner-min. Rate = (2086 - 4x45)/7978 = 0.239 s per slot-s. Per-run selection 3855 slot-s gives 3855x0.239 + 3x45 = 921 + 135 = 1056 s = 17.6 runner-min, saving 17.2 runner-min per per-run run (-49%). Run 41140529141's cells (337+531+556+381 = 1805 s = 30.1 min) give rate 0.204 and a prediction of 785 + 135 = 920 s = 15.3 runner-min. Wall per cp1252 cell is about 1285x0.239+45 = 352 s (5.9 min), against a plain windows part of about 1602x0.239+45 = 428 s (7.1 min); 2 parts would be 1928 slot-s, more than a plain part, which is why 3. Release tier: the whole leg in 3 cells is about 2670x0.239+45 = 683 s (11.4 min) per cell, under resample's measured 22m00s. outcome.descriptive: Per-run CI now runs the Windows cp1252 leg only over the suites the pass is about, derived from the variables the pass sets (16 of 193 files, about half the slot-seconds, on 3 cells instead of 5), and release runs it whole. gate-parity's encoding_leg_drift fails the build if that split breaks. prove-gates still needs two rows for the new lint.
